verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs cover its runtime Loader for fetching common asset types (images, atlases, audio) and an editor/MCP agent for interactive scene building, but there is no evidence of asset-import automation tooling (import hooks, preset-based pipelines, or scripts that batch-process incoming source assets before they reach the game) as a build-time pipeline feature. Missing for 10: any documented import-hook API, preset/config-driven asset processing, or pipeline scripting for automating asset ingestion.
